skill.displayName: Text to speech using the default macOS "say" command. No need for 3rd party APIs or models. Supports many languages. Also, Trinoids!
skill.summary: Local text-to-speech using macOS `say` + ffmpeg for Telegram/Matrix voice messages

latestVersion.changelog:
- Add detailed documentation for using macOS `say` with ffmpeg to generate Opus/OGG voice messages for Telegram/Matrix.
- Explain why converting to Opus format is required and outline recommended audio workflow.
- Provide usage examples, tips for selecting voices and mapping languages, and workspace directory suggestions.
- Discuss current OpenClaw integration limitations and propose potential enhancements.
- Include TODOs for future language detection, integration, and compatibility testing.
